name: gum-org
description: Bun workspace over the gum.jsx package checkouts, so their semver ranges resolve to the sibling directories before publishing

scripts.typecheck: bun run types && for p in gum-jsx-core gum-jsx-docs gum-jsx-math gum-jsx-node gum-jsx-mark gum-jsx-web gum-jsx-react gum-jsx; do echo "== $p" && (cd $p && bun tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: cd gum-jsx && bun test/run.ts && cd ../gum-jsx-react && bun scripts/test.tsx && cd ../gum-jsx-web && bun scripts/test.ts
scripts.types: for p in gum-jsx-core gum-jsx-docs gum-jsx-math gum-jsx-node gum-jsx-mark gum-jsx-web gum-jsx-react gum-jsx; do (cd $p && bun -e "process.exit(require('./package.json').scripts?.types ? 0 : 1)" && echo "== $p" && bun run types) || true; done
